verified_facts.text: The Lodge at Woodloch is an all-inclusive spa resort in the Poconos, Pennsylvania.
verified_facts.excerpt: our all-inclusive spa resort in Poconos, Pennsylvania gives you an opportunity to shift from your everyday routine

verified_facts.text: The resort offers over 50 classes and offerings per day.
verified_facts.excerpt: With over 50 unique classes and offerings per day, there are endless things to do at our resort in the Poconos.

verified_facts.text: All packages include accommodations and three consecutive gourmet meals per night of stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: All packages at our Pennsylvania resort include lavish accommodations, three consecutive artfully-crafted gourmet meals per night of stay

verified_facts.text: Packages include speakers and workshops, creative arts, group fitness and mind/body classes, cooking and baking demonstrations, and group outdoor adventure excursions.

verified_facts.text: Included health and fitness amenities feature an indoor pool, Hydromassage WaterWalls, indoor and outdoor whirlpools, steam rooms, saunas, a Snow Room, a Tyrolean Bucket Shower and a Himalayan Salt Sauna.

verified_facts.text: The Aqua Garden has Hydromassage WaterWalls and an activity pool with floor-to-ceiling windows surrounded by nature.
